installs.label: Installs
installs.definition: Number of new Rapido app installations in the reporting period. An installation does not necessarily represent a new customer: an existing customer can uninstall and reinstall the app.
caveats: Counts app installations, not unique lifetime people.
Do not manufacture monthly distincts by summing shorter-period or channel distinct counts.

registrations.label: Registrations
registrations.definition: Number of customers completing their first registration with Rapido in the reporting period. A customer registers only once; reinstalling the app or logging back in does not create another registration.
caveats: Not AppsFlyer af_reg.
Current month-scoped extraction ranks records within the selected month and does not by itself prove lifetime-first registration or legacy export parity.

platform_ftu.label: Platform FTU
platform_ftu.definition: Number of customers completing their first-ever Rapido ride in the reporting period. A completed ride has dropped status. A customer becomes a Platform FTU only once, regardless of service.
caveats: Counted independently across services; not the sum of Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU counts.
Distinct from Service FTU (SVN), where an existing customer tries another Rapido service for the first time.
Source platform-new flagging is not independently verified first-dropped-ride proof unless separately certified.

platform_link_ftu.label: Bike/Link PFTU
platform_link_ftu.definition: Number of customers whose first-ever completed Rapido ride in the reporting period was on the Bike/Link (`link`) service.
caveats: Measures first-ever Rapido ride on Bike/Link (PFTU), not Bike/Link Service FTU (SVN).
Bike/Link is measured as the single `link` service category under DEC-023, replacing the earlier seven-service membership; the physical source mapping remains uncertified.

platform_auto_ftu.label: Auto PFTU
platform_auto_ftu.definition: Number of customers whose first-ever completed Rapido ride in the reporting period was on Auto.
caveats: Measures first-ever Rapido ride on Auto (PFTU), not Auto Service FTU (SVN) from existing Bike or Cab customers.

platform_cab_ftu.label: Cab PFTU
platform_cab_ftu.definition: Number of customers whose first-ever completed Rapido ride in the reporting period was on Cab. Cab excludes c2c.
caveats: Measures first-ever Rapido ride on Cab (PFTU), not Cab Service FTU (SVN) from existing Bike or Auto customers.
Excludes c2c, while unselected services still count in independent Platform FTU when platform-new.

i2r.label: Install-to-Registration Ratio
i2r.definition: Registrations relative to app installations in the same reporting period.
caveats: Compares period totals, not a matched install cohort; do not cap at 100%.
Aggregate approved counts before dividing; never average city ratios.

r2n.label: Registration-to-PFTU Ratio
r2n.definition: Customers becoming Platform FTUs relative to registrations in the same reporting period.
caveats: Compares period totals, not a matched registration cohort; customers who registered in earlier months can become Platform FTUs this month, so values can exceed 100%.
Distinct from RR2Net (ride-request fulfilment to dropped rides).
Aggregate approved counts before dividing; never average city ratios.

link_share.label: Bike/Link PFTU Share
link_share.definition: Bike/Link PFTUs relative to all Platform FTUs in the reporting period.
caveats: Reported Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU shares need not sum to 100%.
Inherits Bike/Link PFTU provenance and proxy caveats for the underlying month.

auto_share.label: Auto PFTU Share
auto_share.definition: Auto PFTUs relative to all Platform FTUs in the reporting period.
caveats: Reported Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU shares need not sum to 100%.

cab_share.label: Cab PFTU Share
cab_share.definition: Cab PFTUs relative to all Platform FTUs in the reporting period.
caveats: Reported Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU shares need not sum to 100%; Cab excludes c2c.

absolute_delta.label: Absolute Change
absolute_delta.definition: Period-over-period difference in a count metric (latest count minus previous count).

growth_fraction.label: Volume Growth
growth_fraction.definition: Relative change in a count metric over the previous period count; unavailable when either operand is missing or the previous count is zero.

delta_pp.label: Ratio Movement
delta_pp.definition: Signed percentage-point difference between the latest and previous fractional ratios (for example, 40% to 45% is +5pp, not +5%).

link_vs_auto_share_gap.label: Bike-Auto Share Gap
link_vs_auto_share_gap.definition: Difference between Bike/Link PFTU share and Auto PFTU share in the same period; period movement is 100 * (latest gap - previous gap) in percentage points.

platform_ftu_target.label: Platform FTU Target
platform_ftu_target.definition: Planned number of Platform FTU (first-ever completed rides) for a month, supplied by the city-level target plan. The plan carries a national Grand Total, per-city targets and a New launch fallback; these are planning inputs, not observed actuals or commitments.

grand_total.label: Grand Total
grand_total.definition: Authoritative overall target for the month. It is independent of the summed city targets and is not reconciled to them; the pooled New launch fallback never changes it.

city_target.label: City target
city_target.definition: Planned target for one canonical city. Attingal and Trivandrum targets are combined under Trivandrum; Ludhiana keeps its T2-source target while its observed tier is unchanged.

new_launch_fallback.label: New launch fallback
new_launch_fallback.definition: Single planning target for all observed cities absent from the plan, compared against their combined observed Platform FTU. It is not an allocation, per-city target, shared budget or launch evidence; explicit missing or nonpositive city targets do not join the pool.

target_shortfall.label: Target Shortfall
target_shortfall.definition: Signed gap between an assigned target and its observed Platform FTU, for a matched city or the pooled New launch group. A positive shortfall is a target miss and a negative shortfall is an overshoot; missing operands make it unavailable, never zero.

shortfall_percentage.label: Shortfall Percentage
shortfall_percentage.definition: Shortfall relative to the assigned positive target (a city's plan target or the pooled New launch target), displayed as a percentage. It is unavailable for missing operands or a nonpositive target, while the valid absolute shortfall remains available.

target_shortlist.label: Material Target Miss Shortlist
target_shortlist.definition: Policy-based list of cities whose own target miss is material. Arithmetic and ordering come from reviewed tools; this is not a severity, forecast or causal claim.
target_shortlist.eligibility: Strictly more than 5% below the city's own positive target; exactly 5% and smaller misses are excluded, and missing operands or nonpositive targets cannot qualify.
target_shortlist.ordering: Ranked by absolute Platform FTU shortfall descending, then city name.
target_shortlist.coverage_selection: Top mode selects in that order until cumulative shortfall covers X = max(overall target - observed actual, 0); all mode returns every qualifying city even when X is zero. The threshold is never relaxed.
target_shortlist.match_queue: Default plan-matched queue: cities with an explicit city target in the plan, selected and ranked on their own.
target_shortlist.fallback_queue: Unplanned cities are excluded from the default queue and returned only on explicit request as one pooled comparison of their non-null Platform FTU sum against the single New launch target, with an actual-only per-city breakdown. Every unplanned city has no individual target or shortfall.
target_shortlist.tier_scope: For a tier, the target, actual and gap use only plan-matched cohort cities; unplanned cities stay outside that tier calculation and are reported separately as the national New launch pool. National Grand Total reporting is unchanged.

target_persistence.label: Persistent Target Miss (Widening Shortfall)
target_persistence.definition: Annotation of a currently returned material target miss whose gap also widened against the immediately previous stored month.
target_persistence.eligibility: A currently returned plan-matched city must be strictly more than 5% below its own positive target in the selected month and also strictly more than 5% below its own positive explicit city target in the immediately previous calendar month.
target_persistence.comparison: Listed only when current shortfall percentage minus previous shortfall percentage is strictly greater than 5 percentage points, evaluated with exact integer arithmetic before display rounding.
target_persistence.scope: Only currently returned page cities with an explicit plan city target are checked; pooled New launch fallback cities have no individual target and are never annotated.
target_persistence.tier_scope: The selected month's stored tier is the only tier source; the prior month's tier is not required to match.
target_persistence.limits: A city that missed both months but improved is not listed. Absence is not evidence that a city met earlier targets or that the prior month was complete.

svn.definition: A customer taking a particular Rapido service for the first time, even after completing earlier rides on another Rapido service. GrowthOS V1 service breakdowns measure service PFTU (first-ever Rapido ride), not SVN.

rr2net.definition: Ride-request fulfilment ratio (dropped rides relative to ride requests). GrowthOS R2N is Registration-to-PFTU, not RR2Net.

rules.reporting_period: Completed calendar months in Asia/Kolkata; adjacent months are MoM and nonadjacent pairs are period comparisons.
rules.missing_and_zero_values: Missing city-month observations or operands remain null (unavailable), never zero. Zero denominators or zero baselines make ratios or growth unavailable while valid absolute deltas remain available.
rules.aggregation: Sum approved counts across complete cohorts before dividing ratios; never average city ratios or sum monthly unique counts into multi-month distinct totals. Incomplete cohort totals stay null alongside labeled known_subtotal values.
rules.interpretation: Arithmetic and funnel movements describe observations, not proven marketing, CRM, pricing, or supply causality. Stored month_metadata governs actual extraction provenance.
